method.denominator: kuromoji0.1.2 content words; excludes particles, auxiliaries, proper-noun tags, numbers, non-independent forms and documented speaker/ruby/name masks
method.matching: same NFKC exact surface/lemma and contiguous-compound matching in both profiles; table forms only, no incidental example tokens, no undeclared synonyms or homophone aliases
method.limits: Matching is form-level. Same form does not prove correct sense, phrase comprehension or learner retention. Manual semantic audit is separate.
method.aggregation: segment -> work -> genre; anime/manga50/50; no claim of population inference
